note: Wednesday PM refresh, Week 12. This morning's adds ran as free-agent pickups: Rodriguez to ENOTS, Justice Hill to mfkr, Mumpfield to ENOTS, so all three are off the board. Kaleb Johnson is the claim, as a free agent before tonight. 2026-11-26 PM: Thanksgiving refresh. Added Sam Roush (avoid) after Colston Loveland's knee injury; Jack Bech downgraded further as Brock Bowers practiced Thursday; Tuten missed a second practice, which keeps LeQuint Allen Jr. on watch.

targets.why: Engram caught 6 of 8 targets for 74 yards against Las Vegas (CBS Sports, Nov. 24) and clears this league's median rostered tight end over both the last week and the window.
targets.asset: A target-earning tight end in Denver's passing game.
targets.rate_basis: window (wks 9, 11): snap 48%, tgt 20%, 6.5 targets a game; wk 11 tgt 25%

targets.hook: Top healthy Rams pass catcher with Nacua, Ferguson done
targets.why: Puka Nacua and Terrance Ferguson are both out for the season (SI, Nov. 23), and Davante Adams is not due back before Week 13. Higbee has 31 catches for 304 yards on 43 targets (Yahoo, Nov. 24).
targets.asset: A streaming tight end with a bigger share of a thinned-out target tree.

targets.confidence_why: Clear path to targets, but a 13% share so far.
targets.competition: Several rivals stream TEs, but none in this week's feed has a TE hole with money.

targets.why: Felton has 17 targets across Kirk Cousins' two starts, with Jordan Addison hurt (thumb) and Jauan Jennings just back from a calf injury (CBS Sports, Nov. 24).
targets.asset: A volume receiver for as long as Addison is out.

targets.my_team_impact: Not a starter over Odunze, Pickens or Egbuka; a Week 14 option when Pickens is on the DAL bye.

targets.hook: Tuten DNP twice; Allen is JAX RB2 behind ENOTS' Rodriguez
targets.why: Bhayshul Tuten was Jacksonville's only non-participant on Wednesday's report (Jaguars On SI, Nov. 25). Chris Rodriguez Jr. would start if Tuten sits; The Big Lead names Allen as the other backup. Rodriguez is now rostered by ENOTS.
targets.asset: A change-of-pace back with no established touches; only valuable if Tuten sits and Allen gets real work behind Rodriguez.
targets.rate_basis: usage-recent wks 10-11: snap 16% / 19%, zero touches in Week 10
targets.my_team_impact: Would not start for you. He is the only Jaguars back left on the wire to cover Tuten, but his usage says Rodriguez, not Allen, takes the carries.
targets.confidence_why: Below 20% of snaps with almost no touches; any role is hypothetical.
targets.bid: pass for now; revisit only if Tuten is ruled out Friday.

targets.hook: Two TDs on a 64% snap share; role growing
targets.why: Hurst caught 5 of 7 for 56 yards and two touchdowns at Detroit, his snap share rose to 64%, and the team said it plans to feature him more (Yahoo, Nov. 24). RotoWire called the scores late and semi-fluky.
targets.asset: A rising third receiver with red-zone looks while Jalen McMillan is out.
targets.rate_basis: recent-trend (wk 11): snap 64%, tgt 23%, 7 targets, rz 2; wks 9, 11 tgt 13%
targets.my_team_impact: Bench depth behind Egbuka in the same offense.
targets.confidence_why: One game of usage at this level.

targets.hook: Barkley's handcuff, back from a foot injury
targets.why: Saquon Barkley was upgraded to full in Tuesday's walkthrough ahead of Thanksgiving at Dallas (Yahoo, NFL.com, Nov. 24); Shipley, limited Tuesday, played 19 snaps to Barkley's 34 in Week 11 (PhillyVoice, Nov. 23).
targets.asset: A volume start only if Barkley is ruled out.
targets.my_team_impact: Thursday game; useful to you only if Barkley sits and you need a Week 12 back.

targets.hook: Three TDs at Denver; you start Mahomes
targets.why: Mendoza threw for 267 yards and three touchdowns with 22 rushing yards at Denver (Yahoo, Nov. 24).
targets.asset: A streaming quarterback with some rushing.
targets.my_team_impact: Mahomes practiced fully Tuesday, so there is no QB need; LV is on bye in Week 13.

targets.why: ENOTS dropped Ayomanor this morning. With Wan'Dale Robinson out, Chimere Dike has led Tennessee in targets three straight games (feed, Nov. 24), and Ayomanor's share fell in Week 11.

targets.hook: Pittman back from IR, Rudolph at QB
targets.why: Bernard caught 6 of 10 targets for 40 yards against Philadelphia after DK Metcalf was ejected (CBS Sports, Nov. 24). Pittsburgh benched Aaron Rodgers for Mason Rudolph on Friday, and Michael Pittman Jr. is expected back from IR for the same game (Yahoo, NFL.com, Nov. 24-25).
targets.asset: Fourth receiver once Pittman returns, with a backup quarterback throwing.
targets.rate_basis: recent-trend (wk 11): snap 94%, tgt 23%, 10 targets; wks 10-11 tgt 18%
targets.confidence_why: Usage came from an ejection, and the room gets more crowded Friday.

targets.hook: Bowers practicing again; LV bye in Week 13
targets.why: Bech caught 8 of 9 targets for 88 yards and a touchdown at Denver with Brock Bowers out (Yahoo, Nov. 24). FantasyPros lists him as fool's gold. Bowers was back on the field Thursday with his ankle wrapped and Klint Kubiak calls him day to day (CBS Sports, Nov. 26), which would take Bech's extra targets back.
targets.asset: A one-game spike tied to Bowers' absence.
targets.rate_basis: recent-trend (wk 11): snap 79%, tgt 24%, 9 targets; wks 9-11 tgt 19%
targets.my_team_impact: Las Vegas is on bye in Week 13 alongside Jeanty, so he cannot cover that week.

targets.hook: Week 12 window gone; GB ran 14 times for 55 yards
targets.why: His case was Wednesday night with Josh Jacobs (finger) out, and that game is over: Green Bay lost 26-13 at the Rams and ran only 14 times for 55 yards as a team (Yahoo, Nov. 25), with Johnson's one noted play a 19-yard catch on the opening drive. Jacobs practiced on a limited basis last week and the long gap before Week 13 points to his return.
targets.asset: A bench back behind Jacobs once he returns; the stand-in role produced little in its last chance.
targets.rate_basis: usage-recent wks 9-10: snap 39% / 26%, touch share 24% / 22%, 14 and 10 touches; no Week 11 line (bye)
targets.my_team_impact: No longer a fit for the Tuten problem: his game has been played, so he cannot fill your Sunday FLEX. Look at the RB rows below for Sunday cover instead.
targets.confidence_why: The role depended on Jacobs sitting, and the team ran the ball 14 times in the one game it existed.
targets.competition: mfkr (6 left), ENOTS (3) and DiaperDutyDaddy (2) are near broke; nobody with money has shown RB need today.
targets.bid: Pass: nothing left to add him for this week.

targets.hook: Mitchell hurt, but Herbert in protocol
targets.why: Keaton Mitchell left Week 11 with knee and back injuries; RotoWire rates Vidal a desperation play (Nov. 23). Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol (UPI, Nov. 23).
targets.asset: A share of a weak offense.
targets.rate_basis: window (wks 9-11): snap 33%, touch 13%, 7.7 touches a game
targets.my_team_impact: Not a Week 13 answer you would start.

targets.hook: Bears TE with Loveland carted off; 5% target share
targets.why: Colston Loveland was carted off with a left knee injury in the first quarter on Thanksgiving and ruled out, with no diagnosis yet (ESPN, Nov. 26). With Cole Kmet out for the season, rookie Sam Roush and Stephen Carlson are Chicago's only other tight ends, which is why Roush is trending.
targets.asset: A blocking-first backup. Bears targets on Thanksgiving went to Rome Odunze (9), D'Andre Swift (8) and Luther Burden III (7), not the tight end spot.
targets.rate_basis: recent-trend (wk 11): snap 46%, tgt 5%, 1 target; wks 9-11 tgt 5%, 1.5 targets a game
targets.my_team_impact: You start Sam LaPorta and roster Brenton Strange; Roush would not start for you.
targets.confidence_why: Two final weeks as a backup; Loveland diagnosis pending.

targets.hook: High window share, 2 targets in Week 11
targets.why: Harris clears the league median over the three-week window, but drew only two targets in Week 11, and Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol (UPI, Nov. 23).
targets.asset: A fading role in an offense losing its quarterback.
targets.confidence_why: Quarterback uncertainty and a falling last week.

targets.my_team_impact: Would not start over Jeanty, Taylor, Irving or Tuten.
